narrative: Flourished secretary, chancery and italic hands on one sheet, beside which his own playhouse scrawl would look like hen-tracks.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not write on the sheet.

entities.name: Michael Drayton
entities.context: Had brought it, and left it for the minute.

entities.name: the specimen sheet
entities.context: In photo: Three hands on one sheet
